ChatGPT, as tokens

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json: ChatGPT's primitive scales, its two palettes (html, .light, .dark .light for light and .dark for dark), the accent palette it switches with data-chat-theme, its type styles, and the layout numbers measured on the elements. The Dark toggle flips the dark class on <html> and the Accent picker sets data-chat-theme, which is exactly how ChatGPT switches. The drawings below are rebuilt from the tokens; the real pixels are in screenshots/ and components/crops/.

The interface font is the system stack (-apple-system-body, SF Pro on Apple platforms); only the sidebar wordmark asks for OpenAI Sans, which is OpenAI's and is not loaded here, so it falls back to the system face.

Primitive scales

Grey in 25 and 50 steps from white to #0b0b0b, and seven hues from 25 to 1000 with two translucent steps (a50, a75). Nothing in the interface uses these directly; the roles below alias into them.

Colour roles

ChatGPT names colours by role: bg, text, icon, border, surface (the page, sidebar, message and composer grounds), theme (one palette per hue, with a static, text and background step), accent, chart, and interactive, the control states (default, hover, press, inactive, selected) of every button family. Each swatch shows the active theme's value; flip the toggle to compare.

Accent palette

Settings > General > Accent color writes data-chat-theme on <html>. It paints the user bubble, the voice and send button, text selection, the chart ramp and the accent pills; the rest of the interface stays grey. White is data-chat-theme="black". The account was captured on Blue.

Type

One family for everything: the system stack. The thread reads 16/26, the sidebar, menus and settings 14/20, thread headings 18/28 at 600, page titles 24 to 28 at 500. These are ChatGPT's named text styles, each a composite token.

Shape and size

Rows are 36 tall with radius 10, controls radius 8, menus and the composer go rounder (20 and 28), and anything pill-shaped is fully round. The spacing unit is 4px (--spacing).

Measured sizes

Elevation

Dark mode barely uses shadow: popovers and the composer carry a 1px inset white ring at 20%, and dialogs add one 8/16 drop. Light mode draws the composer with a 1px ring at 4% and two soft layers. The Tailwind shadow scale is declared too.

Motion

Hover fills and colour changes run 150ms on Tailwind's ease-in-out. Larger moves use spring curves written as linear() (listed under notTokenised, since DTCG easing is cubic-bezier only), with their durations here. Click a track to play it.

Layout at 1440 x 900

A 260 wide sidebar (52 when collapsed to the rail), a 52 tall page header, and one 768 wide column for the composer and the thread, centred in what is left.

At 390 wide the sidebar becomes a 260 wide drawer over the page, the header keeps 52, and the composer is 358 wide at x 16 with two rows (87 tall, radius 26).
